name: STNet Powerico Data Center (Shin-Takamatsu)
notes: Regional carrier data center in Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture. Official Powerico location page confirms the facility and its disaster-resilience design (base-isolation structure, PL=0 liquefaction, ~4km from coast at 14.5m elevation). Capacity not published.

name: Kyndryl Takamatsu Data Center
notes: Aggregator listing (Baxtel) of an enterprise facility in Takamatsu, Kagawa; not re-verified against an operator page in this pass. Treat as lead.

name: IDC Frontier Kanagawa Yokohama Data Center
developer: IDC Frontier (business inherited by SoftBank Corp. effective 2026-04-01)
notes: Urban-type data center in the Kanagawa Yokohama Bay Area near Minato Mirai 21; listed on IDC Frontier official locations page. Capacity not published.

name: NTT Global Data Centers Keihanna OSK11
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: Officially opened April 2026 in Seika Town, Soraku District, Kyoto Prefecture (Keihanna Science City); air-cooled, 30MW IT load across ~10,900 sqm; NTT's 14th data center in Japan.

name: Colt DCS Osaka Keihanna Data Center
notes: 45MW-class, ~42,000 sqm facility in Keihanna Science City (Hikaridai 1-Chome-6-6, Seika Town, Kyoto Prefecture). DCD covered the groundbreaking; PRNewswire reported the opening March 2026.

name: AT TOKYO Okinawa Data Center (DC3)
notes: AT TOKYO official data-center information page lists an Okinawa data center supporting BCP/backup of the Chuo Center campus; existence A-grade, capacity unpublished.

name: Canon IT Solutions Okinawa Data Center
notes: Official Canon pages describe the Okinawa Data Center as the first in Okinawa Prefecture to run on renewable energy; enterprise colocation facility.

name: Telehouse Naha
notes: Aggregator listing (Baxtel) only; not confirmed on Telehouse official Japan locations page in this pass. Treat as lead.

name: Global Broadband Ginoza Village IT Operation Park
notes: Aggregator listing of ~3 facilities including Ginoza Village IT Operation Park (Okinawa); unverified with operator page.
